steps.sql: ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION SET PREVIEW_FEATURES=ON; CREATE TABLE t(id int CONSTRAINT PK_t PRIMARY KEY,v vector(3)); WITH nums AS (SELECT TOP(0) ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns) INSERT t SELECT n,CONCAT('[',((n*47)%997)/997.0,',',((n*71)%991)/991.0,',',((n*113)%983)/983.0,']') FROM nums;
CREATE VECTOR INDEX vi ON t(v) WITH(METRIC='cosine');
SELECT index_id,build_parameters FROM sys.vector_indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('t');

DECLARE @q vector(3)='[0.251,0.391,0.733]'; SELECT s.id,distance FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TABLE=t AS s,COLUMN=v,SIMILAR_TO=@q,METRIC='cosine',TOP_N=10) ORDER BY distance,s.id; SELECT TOP(10) id,VECTOR_DISTANCE('cosine',v,@q) AS distance FROM t ORDER BY distance,id;
